def mi_based_keff(mi_matrix, model_indices):
    K = len(model_indices)

        for j_idx in model_indices:
            if i_idx != j_idx:

def compute_individual_asr(clean_list, attacked_list, pairs):

    n_flips = n_correct = 0
    for i in range(n):

        if clean_list[i].get("winner", "tie") == gt:

## 1. Reliability Diagram（校准图）

**用途**：显示模型 confidence bin vs accuracy，对角线 = 完美校准。

```python
def plot_reliability_diagram(confidences, accuracies, n_bins=10,
                              label='', color='#0072B2',
                              title='Reliability Diagram',
                              outpath='reliability.pdf'):
    """
    confidences, accuracies: 各样本的 confidence 和 binary correct (0/1)
    """
    bin_edges = np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1)
    bin_accs, bin_confs, bin_counts = [], [], []

    for i in range(n_bins):
        lo, hi = bin_edges[i], bin_edges[i+1]
        mask = (confidences >= lo) & (confidences < hi)
        if mask.sum() > 0:
            bin_accs.append(accuracies[mask].mean())
            bin_confs.append(confidences[mask].mean())
            bin_counts.append(mask.sum())
        else:
            bin_accs.append(float('nan'))
            bin_confs.append((lo + hi) / 2)
            bin_counts.append(0)

    bin_accs = np.array(bin_accs)
    bin_confs = np.array(bin_confs)

    fig, (ax_main, ax_hist) = plt.subplots(
        2, 1, figsize=(4, 4.5), gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [3, 1]},
        sharex=True
    )

    # 主图：gaps
    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                color=color, alpha=0.7, label='Accuracy', zorder=2)
    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_confs - bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                bottom=bin_accs, color='red', alpha=0.3, label='Gap', zorder=2)
    ax_main.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', linewidth=1, zorder=3, label='Perfect')
    ax_main.set_xlim(0, 1); ax_main.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax_main.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
    ax_main.set_title(title)
    ax_main.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
    ax_main.grid(True, alpha=0.3, zorder=1)

    # ECE annotation
    ece = np.nansum(np.array(bin_counts) / sum(bin_counts) *
                    np.abs(bin_accs - bin_confs))
    ax_main.text(0.98, 0.02, f'ECE={ece:.3f}', transform=ax_main.transAxes,
                 ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=9,
                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))

    # 直方图（样本密度）
    ax_hist.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_counts, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                color=color, alpha=0.5)
    ax_hist.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=9)
    ax_hist.set_xlabel('Confidence')

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
```

```python
def plot_ece_heatmap(delta_ece_matrix, methods, datasets,
                     title='ΔECE Heatmap (vs FP16)',
                     outpath='ece_heatmap.pdf'):
    """
    delta_ece_matrix: shape (n_methods, n_datasets), 正=ECE 恶化, 负=改善
    """
    import matplotlib.colors as mcolors

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(len(datasets) * 1.2, len(methods) * 0.8 + 1))

    # 发散色图（中心=0, 红=恶化, 蓝=改善）
    vmax = np.nanmax(np.abs(delta_ece_matrix))
    norm = mcolors.TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-vmax, vcenter=0, vmax=vmax)
    cmap = plt.cm.RdBu_r

    im = ax.imshow(delta_ece_matrix, cmap=cmap, norm=norm, aspect='auto')

    # 数值标注
    for i in range(len(methods)):
        for j in range(len(datasets)):
            val = delta_ece_matrix[i, j]
            if not np.isnan(val):
                color = 'white' if abs(val) > vmax * 0.6 else 'black'
                sign = '+' if val > 0 else ''
                ax.text(j, i, f'{sign}{val:.1%}', ha='center', va='center',
                        fontsize=9, color=color, fontweight='bold')

    ax.set_xticks(range(len(datasets)))
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(methods)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(datasets, rotation=30, ha='right')
    ax.set_yticklabels(methods)
    ax.set_title(title)

    cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046, pad=0.04)
    cbar.set_label('ΔECE (quantized − FP16)')
    cbar.ax.axhline(0, color='k', linewidth=0.8)
```

```python
def wilson_ci(p, n, z=1.96):
    if n == 0: return 0, 0
    denom = 1 + z**2 / n
    center = (p + z**2 / (2*n)) / denom
    half = z * np.sqrt((p*(1-p) + z**2/(4*n)) / n) / denom
    return max(0, center - half), min(1, center + half)

# 用法
```

97	def plot_reliability_diagram(confidences, accuracies, n_bins=10,
98	                              label='', color='#0072B2',
99	                              title='Reliability Diagram',
100	                              outpath='reliability.pdf'):
101	    """
102	    confidences, accuracies: 各样本的 confidence 和 binary correct (0/1)
103	    """
104	    bin_edges = np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1)
105	    bin_accs, bin_confs, bin_counts = [], [], []
106	
107	    for i in range(n_bins):
108	        lo, hi = bin_edges[i], bin_edges[i+1]
109	        mask = (confidences >= lo) & (confidences < hi)
110	        if mask.sum() > 0:
111	            bin_accs.append(accuracies[mask].mean())
112	            bin_confs.append(confidences[mask].mean())
113	            bin_counts.append(mask.sum())
114	        else:
115	            bin_accs.append(float('nan'))
116	            bin_confs.append((lo + hi) / 2)
117	            bin_counts.append(0)
118	
119	    bin_accs = np.array(bin_accs)
120	    bin_confs = np.array(bin_confs)
121	
122	    fig, (ax_main, ax_hist) = plt.subplots(
123	        2, 1, figsize=(4, 4.5), gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [3, 1]},
124	        sharex=True
125	    )
126	
127	    # 主图：gaps
128	    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
129	                color=color, alpha=0.7, label='Accuracy', zorder=2)
130	    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_confs - bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
131	                bottom=bin_accs, color='red', alpha=0.3, label='Gap', zorder=2)
132	    ax_main.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', linewidth=1, zorder=3, label='Perfect')
133	    ax_main.set_xlim(0, 1); ax_main.set_ylim(0, 1)
134	    ax_main.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
135	    ax_main.set_title(title)
136	    ax_main.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
137	    ax_main.grid(True, alpha=0.3, zorder=1)
138	
139	    # ECE annotation
140	    ece = np.nansum(np.array(bin_counts) / sum(bin_counts) *
141	                    np.abs(bin_accs - bin_confs))
142	    ax_main.text(0.98, 0.02, f'ECE={ece:.3f}', transform=ax_main.transAxes,
143	                 ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=9,
144	                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))
145	
146	    # 直方图（样本密度）
147	    ax_hist.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_counts, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
148	                color=color, alpha=0.5)
149	    ax_hist.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=9)
150	    ax_hist.set_xlabel('Confidence')
151	
152	    plt.tight_layout()
153	    plt.savefig(outpath)
154	    plt.close()
155	    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')

## 1. Reliability Diagram（校准图）

**用途**：显示模型 confidence bin vs accuracy，对角线 = 完美校准。

```python
def plot_reliability_diagram(confidences, accuracies, n_bins=10,
                              label='', color='#0072B2',
                              title='Reliability Diagram',
                              outpath='reliability.pdf'):
    """
    confidences, accuracies: 各样本的 confidence 和 binary correct (0/1)
    """
    bin_edges = np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1)
    bin_accs, bin_confs, bin_counts = [], [], []

    for i in range(n_bins):
        lo, hi = bin_edges[i], bin_edges[i+1]
        mask = (confidences >= lo) & (confidences < hi)
        if mask.sum() > 0:
            bin_accs.append(accuracies[mask].mean())
            bin_confs.append(confidences[mask].mean())
            bin_counts.append(mask.sum())
        else:
            bin_accs.append(float('nan'))
            bin_confs.append((lo + hi) / 2)
            bin_counts.append(0)

    bin_accs = np.array(bin_accs)
    bin_confs = np.array(bin_confs)

    fig, (ax_main, ax_hist) = plt.subplots(
        2, 1, figsize=(4, 4.5), gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [3, 1]},
        sharex=True
    )

    # 主图：gaps
    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                color=color, alpha=0.7, label='Accuracy', zorder=2)
    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_confs - bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                bottom=bin_accs, color='red', alpha=0.3, label='Gap', zorder=2)
    ax_main.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', linewidth=1, zorder=3, label='Perfect')
    ax_main.set_xlim(0, 1); ax_main.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax_main.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
    ax_main.set_title(title)
    ax_main.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
    ax_main.grid(True, alpha=0.3, zorder=1)

    # ECE annotation
    ece = np.nansum(np.array(bin_counts) / sum(bin_counts) *
                    np.abs(bin_accs - bin_confs))
    ax_main.text(0.98, 0.02, f'ECE={ece:.3f}', transform=ax_main.transAxes,
                 ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=9,
                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))

    # 直方图（样本密度）
    ax_hist.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_counts, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                color=color, alpha=0.5)
    ax_hist.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=9)
    ax_hist.set_xlabel('Confidence')

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
```

## 2. ECE Heatmap（方法 × 数据集 ΔECE）

```python
def plot_ece_heatmap(delta_ece_matrix, methods, datasets,
                     title='ΔECE Heatmap (vs FP16)',
                     outpath='ece_heatmap.pdf'):
    """
    delta_ece_matrix: shape (n_methods, n_datasets), 正=ECE 恶化, 负=改善
    """
    import matplotlib.colors as mcolors

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(len(datasets) * 1.2, len(methods) * 0.8 + 1))

    # 发散色图（中心=0, 红=恶化, 蓝=改善）
    vmax = np.nanmax(np.abs(delta_ece_matrix))
    norm = mcolors.TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-vmax, vcenter=0, vmax=vmax)
    cmap = plt.cm.RdBu_r

    im = ax.imshow(delta_ece_matrix, cmap=cmap, norm=norm, aspect='auto')

    # 数值标注
    for i in range(len(methods)):
        for j in range(len(datasets)):
            val = delta_ece_matrix[i, j]
            if not np.isnan(val):
                color = 'white' if abs(val) > vmax * 0.6 else 'black'
                sign = '+' if val > 0 else ''
                ax.text(j, i, f'{sign}{val:.1%}', ha='center', va='center',
                        fontsize=9, color=color, fontweight='bold')

    ax.set_xticks(range(len(datasets)))
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(methods)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(datasets, rotation=30, ha='right')
    ax.set_yticklabels(methods)
    ax.set_title(title)

    cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046, pad=0.04)
    cbar.set_label('ΔECE (quantized − FP16)')
    cbar.ax.axhline(0, color='k', linewidth=0.8)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""K_eff vs eta_max scatter plot for K=5 panels (Figure 2)."""

import os
os.environ["HF_HOME"] = "/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache"

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/root/cert_manip_resist_eval")

import json
import itertools
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

from src.unified_data_loader import (
    ALL_MODELS, DATASETS, ATTACKS,
    load_all_scores, load_pairs, load_mi_data,
)

POOL_A = {
    "gpt-4.1", "claude-sonnet-4-6", "gpt-4.1-mini",
    "gemini-3.5-flash", "gpt-4.1-nano", "llama3.1-70b",
    "mistral-large", "qwen2.5-32b", "qwen2.5-72b",
}
POOL_A_INDICES = {i for i, m in enumerate(ALL_MODELS) if m in POOL_A}


def mi_based_keff(mi_matrix, model_indices):
    K = len(model_indices)
    if K <= 1:
        return 1.0
    keff = 0.0
    for i_idx in model_indices:
        term = 1.0
        for j_idx in model_indices:
            if i_idx != j_idx:
                term += np.exp(-2 * mi_matrix[i_idx, j_idx])
        keff += term
    return keff / K


def compute_individual_asr(clean_list, attacked_list, pairs):
    n = min(len(clean_list), len(attacked_list), len(pairs))
    n_flips = n_correct = 0
    for i in range(n):
        gt = pairs[i]["ground_truth_winner"]
        if clean_list[i].get("winner", "tie") == gt:
            n_correct += 1
            if attacked_list[i].get("winner", "tie") != gt:
                n_flips += 1
    return n_flips / max(n_correct, 1)


def main():
    print("Loading data...", flush=True)
    mi_data = load_mi_data()
    mi_matrices = {ds: np.array(mi_data["mi_matrix"][ds]) for ds in DATASETS}
    pairs = load_pairs()
    clean, attacked = load_all_scores()

    print("Computing individual ASR...", flush=True)
    ind_asr = {}
    for ds in DATASETS:
        for atk in ATTACKS:
            for mid in ALL_MODELS:
                if mid in clean[ds] and mid in attacked[ds].get(atk, {}):
                    ind_asr[(ds, atk, mid)] = compute_individual_asr(
                        clean[ds][mid], attacked[ds][atk][mid], pairs[ds]
                    )

    all_combos = list(itertools.combinations(range(len(ALL_MODELS)), 5))
    print(f"C(15,5) = {len(all_combos)} panels", flush=True)

    conditions = [(ds, atk) for ds in DATASETS for atk in ATTACKS]

    keff_arr = np.zeros(len(all_combos))
    eta_arr = np.zeros(len(all_combos))
    is_poolA = np.zeros(len(all_combos), dtype=bool)

    for pi, combo in enumerate(all_combos):
        if pi % 500 == 0:
            print(f"  panel {pi}/{len(all_combos)}", flush=True)
        models = [ALL_MODELS[i] for i in combo]

        keffs_ds = []
        for ds in DATASETS:
            keffs_ds.append(mi_based_keff(mi_matrices[ds], list(combo)))
        keff_arr[pi] = np.mean(keffs_ds)

        eta_vals = []
        for ds, atk in conditions:
            asrs = [ind_asr.get((ds, atk, m), 0.0) for m in models]
            eta_vals.append(max(asrs))
        eta_arr[pi] = np.mean(eta_vals)

        is_poolA[pi] = all(i in POOL_A_INDICES for i in combo)

    print(f"Pool A panels: {is_poolA.sum()} (expected 126)", flush=True)
    print(f"K_eff range: [{keff_arr.min():.3f}, {keff_arr.max():.3f}]", flush=True)
    print(f"eta_max range: [{eta_arr.min():.3f}, {eta_arr.max():.3f}]", flush=True)

    r_full, p_full = stats.pearsonr(keff_arr, eta_arr)
    r_poolA, p_poolA = stats.pearsonr(keff_arr[is_poolA], eta_arr[is_poolA])
    print(f"r_full = {r_full:.4f} (p={p_full:.2e})", flush=True)
    print(f"r_poolA = {r_poolA:.4f} (p={p_poolA:.2e})", flush=True)

    # --- Plot ---
    plt.rcParams.update({
        'font.family': 'serif',
        'font.size': 9,
        'axes.labelsize': 10,
        'xtick.labelsize': 8,
        'ytick.labelsize': 8,
        'legend.fontsize': 7,
        'figure.dpi': 300,
        'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
        'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    })

    GRAY = '#999999'
    TEAL = '#009E73'
    other = ~is_poolA

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 4))

    ax.scatter(keff_arr[other], eta_arr[other], s=6, alpha=0.25, color=GRAY,
               label=f'Full pool ($r$={r_full:.2f})', zorder=1, rasterized=True)
    ax.scatter(keff_arr[is_poolA], eta_arr[is_poolA], s=12, alpha=0.6, color=TEAL,
               label=f'Pool A ($r$={r_poolA:.2f})', zorder=2, marker='D', rasterized=True)

    z = np.polyfit(keff_arr, eta_arr, 1)
    p = np.poly1d(z)
    x_line = np.linspace(keff_arr.min(), keff_arr.max(), 100)
    ax.plot(x_line, p(x_line), '-', color='#333333', linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.7, zorder=3)

    ax.set_xlabel(r'$K_{\mathrm{eff}}$ (effective independent judges)')
    ax.set_ylabel(r'$\eta_{\max}$ (max individual ASR)')
    
    # KEY CHANGE: legend upper left, no frame
    ax.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=False, markerscale=2)
    
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

    out_dir = "/root/cert_manip_resist_eval/artifacts/figures"
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig_keff_eta_scatter.pdf', format='pdf')
    fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig_keff_eta_scatter.png', format='png', dpi=300)
    plt.close()

    print(f"\nSaved: {out_dir}/fig_keff_eta_scatter.pdf", flush=True)
    print(f"Saved: {out_dir}/fig_keff_eta_scatter.png", flush=True)
```
